function.name: reverse_input
function.description: Reverses the given input, returning the opposite or inverted form. For strings, it returns the characters in reverse order. For booleans, it returns the negation. For numbers, it returns the negative value. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

input_value.description: The value to be reversed. Can be a string, boolean, or number (integer or float).
